statement: Linux v7.3 IBEX raw_event recognizes 0x42 input only at 54 bytes including report ID, 0x45 at 46 bytes including ID, 0x43 battery at 15 bytes, and 0x79 wireless event at 2 bytes. Both 0x42 and 0x45 are handled under the IBEX branch without an additional Bluetooth-only report gate. Both input formats share control offsets and the shorter 0x45 omits quaternion. The kernel has no 0x47 IBEX raw_event case. Lines 2441-2619.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. 0x45 being named BLE by SDL does not prove it is the sole or actual retail BLE report.
